messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — GPU capacity alarm: us-west inference pool GPU shortage detected. Autoscaler is throttling new pods. Severity: high. Affected routes: /v1/generate (hosted). Estimated impacted reqs/min: 1200. @ops-oncall please investigate.
ops-oncall: Ack. Investigating now. Moving to bridge and will update here. Bridge: https://zoom-redwood/bridge/abc
ops-oncall: Observed spike at 2026-03-15T14:05Z, node pressure increased, preemptions started at 14:07Z. Autoscaler scaled to max but pods pending due to GPU allocation failures.
dinesh: Is this limited to us-west or multi-region? Any automatic fallback to eu-west?
eva: Prometheus shows GPU free < 5% in us-west; eu-west has spare capacity but routing rules will only failover if region-level policy allows. Currently policy=prefer-local with fallback=manual.
ben: Adding canary fallback policy now — will trigger fallback to eu-west for 10% of traffic to reduce load. Pushing change:
```
route: /v1/generate
policy:
  prefer_local: true
  fallback: eu-west
  fallback_fraction: 0.10
```
ben: Change applied to traffic manager. Monitoring for errors.
ops-oncall: Good. Can someone confirm model variant parity in eu-west? We need same quantized model to avoid quality mismatch.
alice: eu-west has v4.1-quantized available and checksum matches prod-tag. Good to go.
carla: Noted customer impact: some requests experiencing 500s and increased latency for ~6% of requests since first alert. Engaged support to monitor key accounts.
dinesh: Root cause hypothesis: autoscaler couldn't provision ephemeral GPU-backed nodes due to recent GPU quota change on us-west cloud account (quota applied by infra provider). I'm seeing quota errors in cloud logs.
ops-oncall: Sharing cloud log snippet:
```
ERROR: Not enough GPUs available to fulfill request. QuotaError: requested=8 available=2
```
ops-oncall: Opening cloud support case (CASE-7892) and contacting provider.
eva: Short-term mitigation: increase fallback_fraction to 0.5, and enable burst-capacity that uses dedicated spare pool (if available). ben can you push?
ben: Pushing fallback_fraction -> 0.5. Also enabling burst-pool attach for us-west (if spare GPUs exist). Doing now.
incident-bot: config-update: route /v1/generate fallback_fraction updated to 0.5 by ben at 2026-03-15T14:20Z
ben: Burst attach requested; cloud API returned 2 extra GPUs attached — not enough to fully resolve but reduces tail. Monitoring.
ops-oncall: Noticed error rate drop from 6% -> 2.8% after changes. Good. Still seeing some pending pods.
dinesh: Action: (1) Short term: keep fallback_fraction 0.5 and monitor for 1h; (2) Engage infra to request quota bump; (3) Postmortem & action items. I'll own quota request.
alice: I'll file the postmortem schedule. Proposed: async writeup + 1-hour review meeting tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Creating JIRA: INFRA-3124
carla: Assigning action item list in JIRA: - follow up with cloud on quota CASE-7892 - update fallback policy to auto-fallback when region-level free GPUs < 10% - run capacity runbook and test failover weekly
ops-oncall: Adding operational note: update oncall runbook to include quota checks in first 5 min checklist.
dinesh: On longer term: need to increase reserved GPU runway for peak by 25% or improve autoscaler responsiveness. Propose spike buffer: reserve 10% dedicated capacity.
eva: Also add telemetry alert for 'gpu_quota_errors > 0 in 5m' to page infra team before customer impact.
ben: I've created a small dashboard showing preemption rate, pending pods, and fallback traffic. Link: https://grafana/redwood/d/xyz
incident-bot: PAGING LOG: 14:05Z alert, 14:07Z preemptions, 14:12Z fallback_fraction 0.10 applied, 14:20Z fallback_fraction 0.50 applied, 14:40Z partial mitigation, 15:00Z steady state with ~2% errors
carla: Customer comms: outreach to top 3 affected accounts drafted. Will send once postmortem draft is ready.
alice: Postmortem created: https://docs.redwood/pms/INFRA-3124. Deadline for draft: 2026-03-16T17:00Z. Review meeting on 2026-03-16T16:00Z.
dinesh: Note for postmortem: attach cloud quota logs, autoscaler traces, decisions to change fallback_fraction and burst attach response times.
ops-oncall: Closing bridge in 20m unless we see regression. Will ping if anything changes.
carla: Action owner list
- dinesh: Cloud quota request & follow-up (CASE-7892) — due 2026-03-16
- ben: Implement auto-fallback when region <10% free GPU — due 2026-03-23
- alice: Postmortem writeup & meeting — due 2026-03-16
- eva: Alert rule for gpu_quota_errors — due 2026-03-18
- ops-oncall: Update oncall runbook — due 2026-03-20

ben: Quick question — should we also add a pre-warm job to keep 1 spare node ready for peak windows? That would increase cost but avoid cold start contention.
dinesh: Put as backlog item (#INFRA-3125). Tentative: evaluate cost vs reliability with finance next week.
ops-oncall: Bridge closed. Leaving thread open for asynchronous updates. :white_check_mark:
carla: I'll post a final impact summary after case closes.
